description: Security Investment Bank Limited is a non-bank financial company incorporated in 1991 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, licensed as an NBFC under Section 282C and regulated by the SECP, and built on a promise of prudent, Shariah-compliant growth. It provides car, solar, bike, house and consumer financing to individuals and businesses from offices in Karachi and Islamabad, and states a highest car-financing limit of PKR 7 million.
headOffice: 502, 5th Floor, Madina City Mall, Abdullah Haroon Road, Saddar, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: sibl.com.pk — about us page (incorporation, regulation, head office and Islamabad office, financing products) and governance page (management) (accessed 2026-10-17)
